title: Lunch and ordinary conversations in the canteen
caption: Order lunch, carry a tray to a seat, eat, return it and get water. Three existing diners now have ordinary conversations and visible table activities.

sections.title: Canteen meals and diners
sections.caption: Lunch service uses posted prices. Seating and water remain available outside hot-service hours.
